title: Provenance
description: Consolidated provenance metadata for any entity — replaces the 5-7 scattered provenance fields that were previously repeated on every entity. Tracks how the data was created, by whom, and whether a human has verified it

source.description: How this entity's data was originally created

confidence.description: Overall confidence score for this entity's data (0.0 = no confidence, 1.0 = fully verified)

importSourceId.description: References importSources[].id on the root document — identifies which import source produced this entity's data. Plain string, not UUID

aiProvenance.description: AI provenance metadata — which AI model produced this data and whether a human has verified it

humanVerdict.description: Human review verdict on AI-generated or imported data

rejectionReason.description: Reason for rejecting or modifying data

verdictAt.description: When the human verdict was recorded

agentTaskId.description: ID of the agent task that created or modified this entity — links to the agent orchestration system
